newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India issues tender to buy 1.0 mln bbls Oct crude.
newsitem.headline: India issues tender to buy 1.0 mln bbls Oct crude.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy one million barrels of crude oil in October, traders said on Friday.
Traders said the tender closes 0800 hours (0230GMT) New Delhi time on August 28 and is valid until 2200 hours (1630GMT) on August 29.
North Sea, African, Middle East and Pacific region crudes are eligible for the tender, they said.
In its September buy tender, IOC took seven cargoes of Dubai crude, two very large crude carriers (VLCC) of Nigerian Qua Iboe crude, and a cargo of Malaysian Miri crude.
